rationale: The case subject is a 3-year-old neutered domestic shorthair cat presenting with nodular dermatitis caused by Exophiala spinifera (phaeohyphomycosis). Leprosy syndrome was mentioned only as a veterinary differential diagnostic consideration in an animal subject. Non-human/veterinary cases are excluded from the clinical gold standard.

evidence_items.source_quote: A 3-year-old neutered domestic shorthair cat was referred for a nodular dermatitis that had appeared 2 months previously.

rationale: This publication is a retrospective review of 15 cases of leprosy diagnosed in Denmark between 1980 and 2010. It compiles aggregate demographic, geographic, and clinical data across a cohort rather than reporting a single individual patient episode. Non-single patient aggregate studies are excluded.

evidence_items.source_quote: Leprosy was predominately imported to Denmark from South- and Southeast Asia (87 %)

rationale: This manuscript details the institutional design and implementation of university postgraduate health education programs at Lúrio University in Mozambique. Leprosy is cited strictly in passing as an epidemiological prevalence percentage (0.006%) within the Nampula province. It does not describe an individual patient case.

evidence_items.source_quote: Nampula is also amongst the provinces in the country with higher rates of intestinal parasites (95%), lymphatic filariasis (12%), cysticercosis (15-57%), schistosomiasis (c.a. 78%), and leprosy (0.006%).

rationale: The case describes an 11-year-old spayed female cat diagnosed with cutaneous nodular and ocular Cryptococcus neoformans infection. Feline leprosy syndrome was cited only as a veterinary differential diagnostic possibility. Non-human/veterinary cases are excluded.

evidence_items.source_quote: An 11-year-old spayed female cat presented with a 6-month history of a progressive skin disease consisting of asymmetric eroded nodules on the head, right paw pad, shoulder and caudal dorsum.

Considering the history and clinical presentation, the differential diagnoses included infectious causes such as systemic mycoses (eg, sporotrichosis, cryptococcosis), feline leprosy syndrome, nocardiosis, neoplasia (eg, squamous cell carcinoma) or immune-mediated diseases such as eosinophilic granuloma complex.

rationale: This article is an aggregate literature review synthesizing findings from 21 case reports and specimen surveys of Mycobacterium lepromatosis infections worldwide. It does not document a single individual patient encounter. Cohorts, reviews, and aggregate data are excluded.

evidence_items.source_quote: Case reports since 2008 have identified M. lepromatosis infection in a further 15 patients, plus two patients with dual infections of M. lepromatosis and M. leprae.

rationale: A report of sarcoidosis with oral involvement in a 12-year-old girl. Leprosy is cited strictly in the background introduction listing granulomatous differential diagnoses for oral lesions, with no patient-level evaluation -> EXCLUDED_NON_TARGET_CASE.

evidence_items.source_quote: The differential diagnosis of oral soft tissue lesions must consider other granulomatous conditions, such as infections (tuberculosis, leprosy, tertiary syphilis, systemic mycoses, and cat-scratch disease)

rationale: This case record unit describes an aggregate cohort of four patients presenting with ENL and leprosy ('All four patients presented with anesthetic skin patches and/or thickened nerves...'). As an aggregate study unit rather than a single-patient clinical episode, it is excluded -> EXCLUDED_NON_SINGLE_PATIENT.

evidence_items.source_quote: All four patients presented with anesthetic skin patches and/or thickened nerves and acid-fast bacilli on slit skin smears and/or a histopathology compatible with leprosy or ENL.

rationale: This record describes aggregate outcome results and steroid reduction across four patients on anti-TNF-alpha therapy for ENL ('Overall, a reduction of at least half in thalidomide and systemic steroids was observed in all four patients...'). Excluded as an aggregate multi-patient unit -> EXCLUDED_NON_SINGLE_PATIENT.

evidence_items.source_quote: Overall, a reduction of at least half in thalidomide and systemic steroids was observed in all four patients on anti-TNF-alpha therapy over a duration of 6 months-2 years.

rationale: A 33-year-old male diagnosed with Granulosis Rubra Nasi and treated with topical tacrolimus. Leprosy appears solely as part of the department's name ('department of dermatology and leprosy') without any patient-level clinical relevance -> EXCLUDED_NON_TARGET_CASE.

rationale: A comprehensive narrative review article on nasopharyngeal tuberculosis, not an individual clinical case report. Leprosy is only cited in an academic differential list of nasopharyngeal diseases -> EXCLUDED_NON_CASE_REPORT.

rationale: This publication describes an educational workshop and survey study evaluating 135 community health agents and endemic combat agents regarding their knowledge and surveillance of leprosy and Chagas disease. It is an aggregate educational study, not an individual clinical case report.

rationale: A 68-year-old male presented with cutaneous metastases from anaplastic thyroid carcinoma. The term 'Leprosy' appears exclusively as part of the department name ('Department of Dermatology, Venereology, and Leprosy') where the patient presented. Leprosy was neither diagnosed nor suspected in the patient.

evidence_items.source_quote: A 68-year-old male presented to the Department of Dermatology, Venereology, and Leprosy of Tirunelveli Medical College Hospital in November 2018 with swelling in the neck and multiple skin-colored nodules, and a single painful ulcer over the anterior chest for 1 month.

rationale: This publication is an aggregate retrospective case series and cohort study analyzing 16 cases of deep venous thrombosis in erythema nodosum leprosum patients from a cohort of 120 patients. It is not an individual single-patient clinical case report.

evidence_items.source_quote: Table 1 presents a series of 16 clinical cases of DVT in ENL patients in the period of thalidomide and corticosteroid use, of which eight were followed in the HEM-FHEMIG and the other cases coming from reports of cases found in the English and Portuguese language literature.

rationale: A 54-year-old male with multidrug-resistant tuberculosis who developed clofazimine-induced skin hyperpigmentation. The mention of leprosy occurs exclusively in the educational discussion describing the pharmacological indications of clofazimine ('It is used in leprosy...'). The patient does not have leprosy, nor was leprosy considered as a differential diagnosis. Therefore, this is an excluded non-target case.

evidence_items.source_quote: It is used in leprosy, multidrug-resistant tuberculosis, lepra reaction, and in other mycobacterial infections.

rationale: This record is an aggregate multi-patient study unit / cohort excerpt describing laboratory evaluations and adverse events across a series of subjects ('all subjects performed the following laboratory evaluations', 'one patient (number 4) was diagnosed with latent tuberculosis'). Because it does not represent an individualized single-patient clinical claim unit, it is excluded under the unit-of-analysis protocol.

rationale: A 62-year-old female presenting with cervical tuberculosis on Pap smear. The mention of Mycobacterium leprae occurs strictly within an educational quiz question regarding the concentration of sulfuric acid used for acid-fast stains ('5% of acid is used for Mycobacterium leprae'). Leprosy was never considered, diagnosed, or relevant to the patient's care.

rationale: A 58-year-old male with chronic sequelae of remote Hansen's disease who presented with malignant transformation of a 20-year-old trophic ulcer into invasive squamous cell carcinoma (Marjolin ulcer). The patient had no active leprosy, no active diagnostic evaluation for M. leprae, and no anti-leprosy treatment was administered. Leprosy is documented strictly as a remote historical past resolved condition and underlying sequela.

evidence_items.source_quote: The patient was a 58-year-old white male with Hansen's disease sequelae.

rationale: A 51-year-old male presenting with pulmonary Schistosoma haematobium infection and HIV. Hansen's disease is mentioned strictly as a past medical history item treated and resolved in the previous year ('He is also a treated case of Hansen's disease in August 2022'). The patient had no active leprosy during this care episode, and the report is focused entirely on pulmonary schistosomiasis.

evidence_items.source_quote: He is also a treated case of Hansen's disease in August 2022.

rationale: A 3-year-old girl with acute lymphoblastic leukemia who developed reactive granulomatous dermatitis (RGD). Leprosy was mentioned only as a theoretical differential entity that was dismissed without testing due to geographic rarity, lack of travel history, and absent pathological features ('Due to the rarity of leishmaniasis and leprosy in her geographic area... additional specialty microbiologic testing was not performed'). It does not constitute a tested or validated clinical claim.

evidence_items.source_quote: Due to the rarity of leishmaniasis and leprosy in her geographic area, absence of travel history, and lack of specific features on pathology, additional specialty microbiologic testing was not performed.

rationale: This record represents an extensive historical and philological treatise analyzing medieval Byzantine medical texts ('Interpreting materia medica. A case study on Ioannes Archiatrus'). It is a scholarly historical commentary and literature review rather than a modern clinical case report involving a contemporary clinical patient care episode. Excluded under the document type and unit-of-analysis criteria.
